company.name: Apollo GraphQL
company.shortDescription: Apollo GraphQL helps developers build better software with a declarative, graph-based approach to API orchestration.
company.description: Apollo GraphQL helps developers build better software faster with a declarative, graph-based approach to API orchestration. With over 1 billion downloads of its open-source software, Apollo has become the standard for working with GraphQL and powers the most innovative brands today. The Apollo GraphOS® platform provides the infrastructure to unify APIs into a composable graph, enabling teams to query data from anywhere and ship new experiences with speed and confidence. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Insight Partners, Matrix Partners, and Trinity Ventures, Apollo is headquartered in San Francisco. Learn more at: https://www.apollographql.com.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based API orchestration platform for building, governing, and operating federated GraphQL graphs that unify data from multiple services for web, mobile, and AI applications.
productsAndServices.name: Apollo GraphOS

productsAndServices.description: An enterprise GraphQL runtime that routes requests across federated subgraphs, with capabilities for performance optimization, security, caching, and observability.
productsAndServices.name: GraphOS Router

productsAndServices.description: A declarative GraphQL orchestration capability for connecting REST APIs and other HTTP services to a GraphQL graph without building custom resolver integrations.
productsAndServices.name: Apollo Connectors

productsAndServices.description: A server that exposes existing GraphQL operations as Model Context Protocol tools so compatible AI agents can discover and use GraphQL APIs.
productsAndServices.name: Apollo MCP Server

productsAndServices.description: A browser-based GraphQL development and management environment for exploring operations, registering schemas, validating changes, and monitoring graph usage.
productsAndServices.name: GraphOS Studio

productsAndServices.description: A GraphQL client library for web, mobile, and other applications that fetches, manages, and caches data from GraphQL APIs.
productsAndServices.name: Apollo Client

aiResearchSummary.text: Apollo GraphQL is focused on developing infrastructure for composed supergraphs, graph linking, and live queries in graph routers. Their research includes systems to limit query handling and infrastructure for queryable supergraph subset representations. These efforts aim to enhance the efficiency and capability of unified graphs, facilitating better application development and user experiences.
